lead: A new `Core` member owes three conformance cases, not one, and the second gate says so late.
body: `every_part_one_member_has_a_conformance_case` wants one; `every_core_class_has_a_conformance_floor_of_three` counts distinct case files per member, and a repeated question does not. Budget three shapes, run `cargo test --test conformance_coverage` first, and never add to `BELOW_THE_FLOOR`.
